title: Angriff auf Geldtransporter – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe - Belohnung ausgelobt

extraction.summaryEn: Unknown offenders attacked a cash-in-transit vehicle in a supermarket car park in Lankwitz and took cash and valuables. The van was later found abandoned near an S-Bahn underpass on Edenkobener Weg; police seek witnesses and offer a reward.
